mapper.select: SELECT '用户数（人）' AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM user UNION ALL SELECT '公告数（篇）' AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM notice UNION ALL SELECT '评论数（条）' AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM comment UNION ALL SELECT '图书类别（种）' AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM category UNION ALL SELECT '书目（本）' AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM booklist UNION ALL SELECT '馆藏书（本）' AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM book_item ORDER BY name

SELECT '借出数量（本）' AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM loans WHERE status IN (1, 2) UNION ALL SELECT '馆藏总量（本）' AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM book_item UNION ALL SELECT '可用馆藏（本）' AS name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_item) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans WHERE status IN (1, 2)) AS value UNION ALL SELECT '借阅影响率（%）' AS name, ROUND( IFNULL( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans WHERE status IN (1, 2)) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_item), 0), 0 ), 1 ) AS value
